name: Cloud-Scene Occlusion Blending
definition: A post-processing technique that blends rendered clouds with the scene by using depth information from opaque objects and the cloud layer to determine visibility and occlusion, preventing clouds from appearing in front of opaque objects incorrectly.
summary: Cloud-Scene Occlusion Blending is a post-processing technique that uses screen-space depth differences to correctly blend clouds with opaque scene objects, avoiding the artifacts of standard alpha blending.
